skills.name: b2c-organic-social-media-marketing
skills.description: Organic growth coach for B2C apps and products on TikTok and Instagram, with no ad spend. Covers account creation, the 7-day warmup before posting, finding content-market fit, hook and caption formulas, CTA placement, riding trends, converting views into downloads, and when to scale to multiple accounts and automate with Post Bridge.
headings: B2C Marketing, Short-Form Video Content Machine

skills.name: multi-account-operator
skills.description: Run 15 to 400+ social accounts without burning them. Covers account-count vs per-channel economics, bulk scheduling and spacing, per-account caption variation, reading per-account results instead of one vague error, telling a platform restriction apart from a real failure, and the recovery playbook for dead tokens and spam limits. For operators already running many accounts, not for someone starting their first.
headings: Diagnose first: what actually fails, per platform
The dominant cause on each platform
The one distinction that saves the most time
Economics: why account count is the unit
